_doc.about: give-up-guard settings. The plugin creates this file on first run; plugin updates never change it. Every value here is the default (same behavior as no file). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Extra pattern files go in patterns/ next to this file.
_doc.secrets: true = also block asks for a password, token or key; false = never. null = use the /config option 'Also block asks for secrets' (off by default). GIVE_UP_GUARD_SECRETS=1/0 wins over this
_doc.headless: true = also check claude -p runs; false = never. null = use the /config option 'Also check claude -p runs' (off by default). GIVE_UP_GUARD_HEADLESS=1/0 wins over this
_doc.reason_suffix: Text appended to every reason Claude sees, e.g. the tools it should try. Empty = none
_doc.reasons: Replaces the text Claude sees for a rule (give_up, not_exists, asks_data, asks_secret, not_checked). Empty = the built-in text
